keyLimits.en: 1 pentest per month included, additional pentests billed at $199 each
5 pentests per month included, additional pentests billed at $149 each, priority support

addOns.en: Extra pentests beyond the monthly allocation, billed per pentest ($199 on Starter, $149 on Professional)

cautions.en: No free plan; a free 5-minute scan is offered as a lead-gen demo, separate from the paid tiers.
Cancel anytime, no lock-in contract stated on the pricing page.

capabilities.en: Autonomous AI-driven penetration testing across web apps, APIs, source code, infrastructure and cloud environments.
Produces audit-ready reports with proof-of-exploit evidence, CVSS severity ratings and remediation guidance, compatible with SOC 2 and ISO 27001 needs.
Auto-generates merge-ready pull requests to fix found vulnerabilities, with automatic retesting.
Continuous/scheduled scanning with CVE coverage and attack-path graph visualization.

limitations.en: No self-service free tier beyond a one-off 5-minute scan; ongoing use requires a paid monthly plan.
Pentest volume is capped per month on both plans (1 on Starter, 5 on Professional); more testing requires paid overage.

reason.en: Automated security testing for code and dependencies aimed at the same engineering-team buyer.
Free/open web app security scanner covering overlapping ground for teams evaluating budget alternatives.
